description: Dept. of Forest Conservation  - Declare that  Vilava  & Swarnagalawa Forests  in Kurunegala District as Reserved Forests
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of forest areas as reserved forests under the Forest Conservation Ordinance. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, coordinates, and extents of the declared forest reserves, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
